Instant Support Agent
How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu
Orders placed before 2:00 PM EST on business days (Monday–Friday) are processed the same day, while orders placed after 2:00 PM EST or over the weekend are processed the next business day.
Once shipped, domestic US orders typically take about 2–4 business days to be delivered via USPS, while international shipments generally take 5–15 business days depending on customs and shipping method.
